items.hypothesis: The clean ForkAudit runtime satisfies replayable, phase-aware KV and GDN ownership contracts; all four cells of a KV materialized/shared by GDN materialized-base/borrowed-immutable-base factorial are semantically exact; the fused full-attention path agrees with an independently implemented FP32 dense-attention oracle on a held-out subset; and every preregistered live ownership or dispatch mutant is rejected at its intended gate.
items.refutation_condition: Any clean false positive; any post-transition request-local GDN interval overlapping another request or the persistent base; any persistent-base value or binding mutation; any cross-cell token, full-logit, logical-KV, or final-GDN divergence; any held-out dense-oracle relative-L2 above 0.005; or any preregistered mutant escaping its intended detector refutes only the corresponding ownership, semantic, or fault-sensitivity claim. A classified mutant escape remains a valid negative experimental result and must not be converted into an infrastructure failure.

primary_endpoint.name: preregistered runtime-mutant detection with clean semantic and ownership gates
primary_endpoint.definition: All clean shards pass; borrowed-base requests show exact immutable-base aliases only before their first transition, while every post-transition mutable GDN range is disjoint from the base and peers; the materialized-base cells are disjoint already at setup; all four ownership-factorial cells are bitwise exact in tokens, full logits, logical KV, and final GDN values; all held-out full-attention rows are finite with FP32-dense relative-L2 <= 0.005; and each live mutant has a complete classified outcome.
primary_endpoint.aggregation: Report exact counts and per-target outcomes across eight held-out PG-19 train books. Do not compute confidence intervals for deterministic gates or average away an escaped mutant.

items.oracle: Independent PyTorch FP32 dense attention over logically gathered Q16 K/V with the same post-RoPE query, scale, position values, and mask; same-kernel fresh/reuse equality remains a separate relational gate.
baselines: unmodified request-local functional GDN with shared-document paged KV
unmodified full-copy document control with the same unified_attention callable
the 2 x 2 ownership factorial: KV full-copy/shared-paged by GDN materialized-request-base/borrowed-immutable-base
prior fair-v2 exploratory FP32 diagnostic used only as a frozen contextual safety-margin check for the independently pre-fixed 0.005 engineering tolerance; it does not tune or select that threshold
controls: wrong live request-sequence binding inside the shared arena
unified_attention callable swap after ledger construction

execution.dataset_split: PG-19 train only; eight deterministic held-out windows distinct from the prior capacity run; no LongBench or test-v2 access

configuration.model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B at full public revision 59d61f3ce65a6d9863b86d2e96597125219dc754; formal preflight must additionally match the existing 14-shard weight ledger
configuration.mutant_case_isolation: Every mutant has a separately rebuilt, no-mutation matched control that runs the identical detector exercise and must produce no false positive, followed by a second freshly rebuilt disposable cache/model-state view for the mutation. Every control and mutant cache is discarded before the next case; hook restoration alone is not treated as state restoration after a faulting append or transition.
configuration.gdn_setup_contract: borrowed policy permits exact immutable-base alias before first transition; materialized policy is request-local at setup; both policies require all 60 completed-request tensors to rebind onto storage disjoint from setup, base, and peers, while incomplete requests retain their setup bindings
configuration.measurement_cell_separation: Ownership-witness cells retain setup tensors by design and are forbidden as memory endpoints. Allocator/capacity endpoints come from separately rebuilt clean measurement cells with no request-binding guard or witness-held setup storage.
configuration.memory_instrumentation_contract: Primary allocator cells disable strict position-value checks, append observers, call observers, tensor hashing, and host-side exactness copies until each allocator endpoint is synchronized and frozen. Every cell is then explicitly destroyed and must return to the frozen model/query allocator baseline before the next cell.
configuration.allocator_endpoint_contract: Each allocator snapshot records current and production-peak allocated/reserved bytes with reserved >= allocated for both windows. Setup-plus-generation uses the maximum of the separately reset setup and generation peaks relative to the post-pack baseline; generation-only uses the post-setup current baseline. These are PyTorch allocator endpoints, not NVML or total process memory.
configuration.raw_artifact_binding: Every witness, oracle row, mutation receipt, and shard is externally SHA-256 bound from raw bytes before aggregation; internal rows_sha256 is described only as a self-consistency check.
configuration.query_bank_binding: Before any candidate output, the path-independent protocol manifest freezes 32 pairwise-distinct query-token SHA-256 rows for each rank. For every N, request i must equal frozen bank row i, and the full N=1 -> N=8 -> N=32 semantic/query prefixes must be exact.
configuration.factor_isolation_contract: After removing per-cell opaque IDs, fixed-KV cells must have identical normalized KV ownership/copy/storage schedules across the two GDN policies, and fixed-GDN cells must have identical normalized GDN content/transition relations across the two KV policies. The aggregate replays the complete group audit and ten-layer storage ledger rather than trusting a policy label or digest alone.
configuration.oracle_sample_binding: Every oracle row is frozen to the unique N=1 shared-paged-KV plus borrowed-immutable-GDN ownership-witness arm and records a deterministic cell selector, rank, PG-19 book/window, document start, layer, step, Q/candidate/position/mask digests, effective live-kernel scale, and the preregistration hash before any candidate output. The static identity also binds the byte SHA of the 80-row prior FP32 diagnostic manifest, verifies that the pre-fixed 0.005 tolerance is at least twice the prior maximum relative-L2, and proves the new 4095-token oracle coordinate is absent from the prior 1025-token coordinate set without claiming that prior data selected the tolerance.
configuration.oracle_input_replay: For the selected full-attention layer, binary sidecars contain the exact BF16 physical document K/V pool (including padding), int32 document table, every ordered pre-write append event through the selected round, and the candidate active table. Blind replay reconstructs logical document K/V from the physical table, concatenates all append events, binds every event to its corresponding live ledger call, and recomputes the IEEE-FP32 oracle under the fixed 0.005 threshold.

execution.repeats_or_seeds: Eight distinct PG-19 train books/windows; deterministic inference. Each mutant is a targeted positive control, not a stochastic replicate.
execution.hardware: one formal 8 x H20-141G job, one independent rank per book and assigned mutant
execution.software: the frozen torch 2.11 / Transformers 5.14.1 / vLLM 0.26 / Triton 3.6 environment used by the prior formal run
execution.resource_estimate: one 8-GPU job; load the model once per rank, run the clean N={1,8,32} 2x2 ownership factorial and semantic oracle, then execute one assigned live mutant per rank plus the N-dependent contamination control
execution.stopping_rule: Fail closed on the first clean-gate failure. Record, but do not hide, every mutant escape; do not retry a scientifically negative result under the same run ID.

preflight: real Transformers 5.14 position test with zero skips
CUDA remains uninitialized during static validation
smoke: CPU storage-range normalization and overlap mutants
aggregate replay rejects a changed detector or raw witness
mutant escape is serialized as a negative scientific outcome rather than crashing or disappearing

injector apply/restore exceptions cannot masquerade as detector hits, each case includes a target-specific pre/post/restore mutation receipt, and every mutant's identical no-mutation exercise passes in its own fresh matched-control cache
formal: ownership-witness cells are separate from clean allocator measurement cells and cannot contribute memory endpoints
each measurement and witness cell is rebuilt independently and returns to its frozen allocator baseline before the next cell
each rank/N request-query prefix is exact against the pre-output frozen PG-19 query-bank manifest
four ownership-factorial cells at N={1,8,32} with factor-specific storage changes and cross-cell semantic equality
fixed-axis normalized KV and GDN receipts prove that each factorial axis changes only its preregistered ownership factor
the preregistered oracle arm binds every append event and selected kernel call to replayed physical-document sidecars and an IEEE-FP32 result

fail_closed: no summary pass if a clean row fails
no positive fault-sensitivity claim if an expected mutant is absent or escapes; the aggregate must still preserve and report the negative outcome
no manuscript exactness or ownership upgrade before independent change verification

outcome_policy.positive: Add bounded evidence that ForkAudit detects the executed fault classes, directly witnesses post-update GDN ownership, and passes a held-out FP32 attention subset; retain one-model and one-runtime limits.
outcome_policy.null: If a detector is inconclusive or an oracle row exceeds the threshold without a diagnosed implementation fault, report the blind spot and keep the affected claim at self-consistency only.
outcome_policy.negative: If a clean ownership or semantic gate fails, remove or narrow the affected headline claim and center the paper on the discovered failure and repaired audit boundary only after a separately identified rerun.

items.hypothesis: A path-independent package can reconstruct the public inputs and frozen identities, execute a smoke subset, and independently replay every newly reported primary endpoint.
items.refutation_condition: The package depends on an author-only absolute path, omits a required ledger/input identity, cannot run headlessly, or cannot regenerate and compare the smoke artifacts.

primary_endpoint.name: clean package closure and smoke rerun
primary_endpoint.definition: A fresh documented environment validates all normalized ledgers, reconstructs the frozen query banks, runs the smoke configuration, and reproduces its registered semantic, ownership, and mutant outputs.
primary_endpoint.aggregation: All required files and commands must pass; package closure is binary and path-independent.

items.oracle: Independent package-closure validator plus byte/digest comparison of reconstructed inputs and regenerated smoke artifacts.

execution.dataset_split: The same frozen PG-19 train subset with public acquisition/reconstruction instructions
execution.repeats_or_seeds: one independent clean smoke rerun plus deterministic offline replay
execution.hardware: CPU for acquisition/static replay and one available compatible GPU for the smoke path; the formal 8-GPU run remains separately registered
execution.software: pinned lock/container identity and one-command headless scripts
execution.resource_estimate: package and CPU work plus the smoke subset piggybacked on the formal review-response run
execution.stopping_rule: Do not label the package clean-rerunnable until a fresh process executes the documented command without hidden files.

formal: new run artifacts and summary are package-relative and registered
fail_closed: missing external weights/data are called prerequisites, not bundled evidence
no hash-only replay is described as tensor recomputation

outcome_policy.positive: Upgrade reproducibility language only to the exact rerun surface independently demonstrated.
outcome_policy.null: Keep offline-replay-only wording and document the remaining external prerequisite.
outcome_policy.negative: Remove clean-rerun claims and preserve the failure log as a registered artifact.

primary_endpoint.aggregation: Zero unsupported transfer claims in the manuscript and claim-evidence map.
